description: This file is a test script for performing various Git merge operations with different strategies; it sets up a repository, makes commits, and tests merge behaviors such as fast-forward, recursive, ours, and subtree merges.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a specified description.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the mock time used in testing for reproducibility.

methods.name: git add
methods.description: Adds file contents to the staging area in Git.

methods.name: git commit
methods.description: Records changes to the repository with a message.

methods.name: git tag
methods.description: Creates a tag object pointing to a certain commit.

methods.name: git reset
methods.description: Resets current HEAD to a specified state.

methods.name: git merge
methods.description: Merges branches or commits into the current branch with various strategies.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Command used within the test script to run assertions.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Stores the expected value for comparison in tests.
